instructions: Is the operator's message asking the agent to do something, or giving it information?

options.label: asking_for_action
options.criterion: a request or an instruction to do something

options.label: giving_information
options.criterion: context, a statement or a description, with nothing to do

options.label: both
options.criterion: a request and information in the same message

options.label: unclear
options.criterion: none of these fits the text
